g.text: No spatial cue in these tasks
All seven sensory tasks use native generators and native difficulty draws. Points are empirical accuracy with Wilson 95% intervals and saved cell
denominators. At a ceiling these data cannot identify thresholds or lapses. Binary interval labels mean frame0/frame1 for stronger evidence, not
generic change/no-change. No cued/uncued allocation comparator is fabricated.
